## Answers

**h01** — **Component:** the S3 presign runner, `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`); its work is `RunOnce` → `CheckAndPresign` (`runner.go:43`, `:47`), which re-presigns S3-stored attachment URLs whose presigned link is within 4 days of its 5-day expiry (`runner.go:85-91`, update at `:116`).
**Schedule:** once immediately at startup, then a ticker every 12 hours — `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`, loop at `:29-41`).
**Wiring:** `Server.startBackgroundRunners` — construction `server/server.go:162`, immediate `RunOnce` `server/server.go:163`, goroutine `Run` `server/server.go:169`; called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02** — **Delivery function:** `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (the `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152` is the actual outbound call); `PostAsync` (`:184`) only enqueues onto `asyncPostQueue`, drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` (`:39-55`).
**Protection:** two layers —
- Dial-time SSRF guard: `safeClient`'s custom `Transport.DialContext = safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-37`, `:59-77`), which resolves the host and refuses any address in a reserved range, defeating DNS rebinding; ranges/check in `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54` (`reservedCIDRs`, `isReservedIP`).
- Config-time validation: `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) — scheme must be http/https and must not resolve to a reserved IP; called when webhooks are created/updated (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74`, `:161`, `:182`).
- Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`), set from the `--allow-private-webhooks` flag at `cmd/memos/main.go:49`.

**h03** — **Abstraction package:** `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3` — `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, the common user-info shape all providers return).
**Implementation package:** `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go` — `NewIdentityProvider` `:27`, `ExchangeToken` `:47`, `UserInfo` `:83`); it is the only concrete protocol shipped, constructed at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:121`.

**h04** — **No.** `mysql.NewDB` is referenced exactly once in the whole repo: the driver-selection switch in `store/db/db.go:22` (declaration at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`). A repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB(`/`NewDB(` returns only `store/db/db.go:20,22,24` plus the three declarations; the only other `mysql.` references are to the testcontainers module in `store/test/containers.go:101-105`, not the driver. Tests that bypass the factory use `sqlite.NewDB` only (`store/demo_seed_test.go:24`, `store/deployment_config_test.go:416`).

**h05** — **Mechanism: explicit Go code**, in the delete-user transaction of every driver; there is no DB-level cascade.
- Explicit deletes: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the deleted user's memos, keyed by `memos/{uid}` content IDs) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions the user authored) — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380` and `:400`, invoked at `:96` and `:102` inside `deleteUserTargetsTx`; identical code at `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:380,400` (calls `:96,:102`) and `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:417,437` (calls `:96,:102`).
- Absence of a DB rule: the `reaction` table is declared with no foreign keys and no `ON DELETE` clause in all three schemas — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98` (contrast `memo_share`, which does have `ON DELETE CASCADE`, `sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`).

**h06** — **Handlers** (all `*APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:513` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:562` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:119` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:48`, and `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:48` (both via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`)

**Convergence:** all of them funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, called at `memo_service_webhooks.go:43` and `:71`), and the single function that performs the outbound HTTP delivery is **`webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`**.

**h07** —
- Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124` (registered from `server/server.go:82`)
- `(*FileServerService).serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (auth gate `:171-180`, MIME allowlist `:201`, blob write `:209`)
- `(*FileServerService).getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `(*store.Store).GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` when finding by ID)
- `(*store.Store).ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` (populates `userCache`, `store/cache/cache.go`)
- `store.Driver.ListUsers` interface dispatch — `store/driver.go`
- `(*sqlite.DB).ListUsers` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (`SELECT ... avatar_url ...`, `:159`)
- Back in the handler: `parseDataURI` decodes the stored `data:` URI base64 into image bytes — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:736`

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked in production** — callers: `server/server.go:163` (startup) and its own ticker loop `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`.
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked anywhere** (neither is `memopayload.NewRunner`); the only production use of that package is the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, `:447`).

**h09** — **Count: 6 concrete method declarations** in non-test backend Go (8 if the two interface declarations are counted; 10 including two test-only helpers at `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`).
Declarations: `*SSEHub.Close` `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`; `*Store.Close` `store/store.go:72`; `*cache.Cache.Close` `store/cache/cache.go:187`; `*sqlite.DB.Close` `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`; `*postgres.DB.Close` `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`; `*mysql.DB.Close` `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`; interfaces: `store.Driver.Close` `store/driver.go:12`, `cache.Interface.Close` `store/cache/cache.go:30`.
Invoked from non-test server code:
- `*Store.Close` ← `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `*SSEHub.Close` ← `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `*cache.Cache.Close` ← `store/store.go:74-76` (three caches)
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` (and, per driver choice, postgres/mysql) ← `store/store.go:78` via `s.driver.Close()`

**h10** — `(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — **≈38 call sites** (highest of any `internal/`-declared symbol). Of those, 7 are non-test: `internal/filter/helpers.go:11`, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:356`, `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:85`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go:87` and `:98`, `store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go:78`; the remaining ~31 are in `internal/filter/*_test.go`. Runner-up: `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go:40`) with ~28 call sites (7 non-test).

**h11** — **1st: `store.User`** — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`); 6 excluding the test package.
**2nd: `store.Memo`** — ~6 packages (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`); 5 excluding tests.
(For comparison: `store.Attachment` 4, `store.MemoRelation`/`store.MemoShare` 3, `store.Reaction` 2.)

**h12** — **Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`**, with the `INSERT INTO \`memo\` ...` statement built and executed at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:40-41`.
**Determination:** the driver is chosen by string, not by build tag — `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the flag default `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122`, `:130`) feed `profile.Driver` (`cmd/memos/main.go:43`), which the factory switches on: `case "sqlite": sqlite.NewDB(profile)` (`store/db/db.go:18-20`). That value is stored as the `store.Driver` interface (`store/store.go:14`, `New` at `:37`), and the API handler path `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:114`) → `(*Store).CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109`) → `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:112`) resolves to the sqlite implementation. The mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` implementations are only reachable with `--driver mysql|postgres`.

**h13** — **Interface:** `markdown.Service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`.
**Implementation:** exactly one — the unexported `*markdown.service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:59`, methods at `:143-455`).
**Construction:** `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`), called in production only at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()` (test construction at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`).
**Holders of the interface:** `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`); `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected from `server/server.go:85`); `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` / the `markdownService markdown.Service` parameter of `RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, `:74`).

**h14** — **Computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which delegates to `(*markdown.service).ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` — and writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (`runner.go:85-86`).
**Triggers:** `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field mask path is applied (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, persisted via `update.Payload` `:451`); plus the batch backfill `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`), which is currently not wired into startup.
**Extracted properties:** deduped `#tags` (`markdown.go:378-380`, `:418`) and `MemoPayload_Property`: `Title` (text of a leading H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode` (code block/fenced/inline), `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:384-408`). Mentions are also extracted in the same pass but used for notifications, not stored in the payload. Related derived preview data — `Memo.Snippet` — is computed per-request rather than stored, via `getMemoContentSnippet` → `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`, used at `memo_service_converter.go:76`).

**h15** — Distinct enforcement sites:
- `(*APIV1Service).checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo reads) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`
- `ListMemos` query scoping (anonymous → PUBLIC; authed → own + PUBLIC/PROTECTED) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- User memo-stats query scoping — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90` and `:218-220`
- File server attachment access (`checkAttachmentPermission`, incl. share-token bypass) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-704` (`:677`, `:699`)
- SSE broadcast filtering (`SSEClient.canReceive`) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143`
- RSS feeds (PUBLIC only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Frontend SSR/metadata rendering (PUBLIC only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Reaction service (upsert/delete) — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-38`, `:83`
- Attachment API access check — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-451`; `ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-222`
- Comment creation on a related memo — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41` (and `:100`)
- Mention/notification suppression for private memos — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62-84`; email notification body gating — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312` and `server/notification/email.go:313-316`

**r01** — **Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in this codebase** (no `redis` import in `go.mod`, no match repo-wide outside `web/`). Caching is an in-process, sharded-free `sync.Map` cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache`, `New` at `:74`, TTL expiry in `SetWithTTL` `:94` and `cleanupLoop`). The `Store` creates three of them — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — with `cache.Config{DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute, CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute, MaxItems: 1000}` at `store/store.go:38-51`. So **user entries expire 10 minutes after being set** (`store/user.go:132`, `:145`, `:160` call `Set`, which applies `DefaultTTL`); they are also invalidated explicitly on update/delete (`store/user.go:170` → `deleteUserCache`). Nothing is configurable via flags or env.

**r02** — **Premise is wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware in this codebase**, per-user or otherwise. A repo-wide search for `ratelimit`/`rate limit`/`golang.org/x/time/rate` outside `web/` yields only a doc-comment aspiration in `internal/email/doc.go:86`. The middleware actually registered on the Echo server is just `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`); the API request pipeline adds only auth/authorization interceptors (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64+`, `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`). The only throttling of any kind is concurrency limiting on image work via semaphores (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:112` — 3 concurrent thumbnails; `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:61-62`) and the bounded 128-slot webhook queue (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`).

**r03** — **Premise is wrong: no cron scheduler is wired into the server, and there is no nightly database-cleanup job.** The `internal/scheduler` package exists but is imported only by its own tests/examples (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`) — nothing in `server/`, `store/`, or `cmd/` uses it. The `"0 2 * * *" // 2 AM daily` "daily-cleanup" job is illustrative text in the package doc comment (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:14-18`), not a registered job. The only recurring background work in the running server is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`, started at `server/server.go:162-171`).

**r04** — **Premise is wrong: neither. There is no message broker** — no NATS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or any broker client in `go.mod`, and no queue is declared anywhere. Webhook delivery uses an in-process Go channel: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 goroutines started in the package `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `webhook.Post` (`:120`). Producers call `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`), which drops the event with a warning if the buffer is full (`:189-195`). The queue is unpersisted and in-memory, so pending deliveries are lost on restart.

**r05** — **Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server** in this repo (no `graphql` match in any Go file or in `go.mod`). The public API is **Protobuf/Connect-RPC**: service and message definitions live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` with generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1/` and Connect handlers in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/`. They are served three ways — Connect/gRPC handlers registered at `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:37-44`, a gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON surface via `(*APIV1Service).RegisterGateway` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64`, mounted at `server/server.go:88`), and an OpenAPI-derived MCP tool surface (`server/router/mcp/openapi.go`, `mcp.NewMCPService` at `server/server.go:92-96`). Additional non-RPC HTTP surfaces are the file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), and SSE (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`).
